# Registry drift audit — 2026-07-29

**Author:** generated by reading `registry/base-nova/`, `packages/registry/src/components/`, and `packages/ui/src/components/` against the tolerance policy in [[2026-07-29-drift-detection]].
**Scope:** all 3 items currently in `registry.json` (`ds-button`, `ds-icon-button`, `ds-colored-badge`).
**Method:** direct file read; no fuzz, no heuristics. Every claim below is verifiable by opening the cited files.

---

## Per-item findings

### `ds-button`

**Three trees carry button-shaped code:**

| Tree | Path | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace source | `packages/ui/src/components/button.tsx` | Real Base UI + cva implementation, exports `Button` and `buttonVariants` |
| Showcase | `packages/registry/src/components/button/index.tsx` | Re-export of the workspace source: `import { Button as ShadcnButton } from "@workspace/ui/components/button"` then `export { ShadcnButton as Button }`. Adds a `ButtonDemo`. |
| Consumer | `registry/base-nova/ds-button/ds-button.tsx` | Independent Base UI + cva implementation, exports `DsButton` and `dsButtonVariants` |

**Classification.** Showcase is `showcase-shim` — it carries no implementation of its own.

**Drift axes present.**

- `workspace-vs-consumer`. Both implement the same component independently. No enforcement relationship.
- `showcase-vs-workspace`. Showcase re-exports the workspace source, so visual layout tracks the workspace automatically. Safe.

**Current state.** Verified by direct read: class-string bases are byte-identical between `packages/ui/src/components/button.tsx` line 7 and `registry/base-nova/ds-button/ds-button.tsx` line 10. Variant keys (`default`, `outline`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `destructive`, `link`) and size keys (`default`, `xs`, `sm`, `lg`, `icon`, `icon-xs`, `icon-sm`, `icon-lg`) match across both. Class strings for each variant and size match across both.

This match was achieved by the maintainer copy-pasting the workspace source into the consumer tree at v1 authorship. There is no tool, test, or hook that preserves the match.

**Risk going forward: HIGH.** Manual sync only. The next edit to either side breaks the equivalence, silently.

**Allowed divergences (intentional / non-actionable).**

- Export names: workspace `Button`, consumer `DsButton`. By convention (`ds-` prefix).
- Import paths: workspace `@workspace/ui/lib/utils`, consumer `@/lib/utils`. Workspace vs consumer convention.

### `ds-icon-button`

**Three trees — but only two carry icon-button-shaped code:**

| Tree | Path | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace source | (none — `packages/ui/src/components/` has no `icon-button.tsx`; icon-button is achieved by `size="icon"` on the workspace Button) | n/a |
| Showcase | `packages/registry/src/components/icon-button/index.tsx` | Wraps the workspace `ShadcnButton` with `size="icon"` and applies a `SIZE_CLASSES` override map (`sm → size-8`, `md → size-10`, `lg → size-12`). Exports `IconButton` and `IconButtonDemo`. |
| Consumer | `registry/base-nova/ds-icon-button/ds-icon-button.tsx` | Independent Base UI impl with its own `iconButtonVariants` cva (`sm → size-8`, `md → size-10`, `lg → size-12`). Exports `DsIconButton` and `iconButtonVariants`. |

**Classification.** Showcase is `showcase-shim`.

**Drift axes present.**

- `showcase-vs-consumer-styling`. Both maintain a `size → size-N` mapping. The two mappings were authored separately but produce identical Tailwind strings today.

**Current state.** Verified by direct read: showcase's `SIZE_CLASSES` constant and consumer's `iconButtonVariants` cva body produce the same `size-8` / `size-10` / `size-12` class strings for the same `sm` / `md` / `lg` keys.

**Risk going forward: MEDIUM.** Two independent size tables must stay aligned. No mechanism guarantees it.

**Allowed divergences.**

- Ergonomics: showcase inherits `aria-label` requirement from `ShadcnButton`'s prop typing; consumer declares `aria-label` directly required on `DsIconButtonProps`. Same outcome at the prop level, different ergonomic.
- Base styling: showcase's `IconButton` adds an additional size override after `ShadcnButton`'s `size="icon"`. Consumer's `DsIconButton` builds size from scratch with a class string that includes the primary button styles plus the size override.

### `ds-colored-badge`

**Three trees — three different shapes:**

| Tree | Path | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace source | `packages/ui/src/components/badge.tsx` | Generic Base UI primitive. 6 visual variants (`default`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `outline`, `ghost`, `link`). Pill-shape (`rounded-4xl`), `h-5`, focus ring, slot/aria machinery. Exports `Badge` and `badgeVariants`. |
| Showcase | `packages/registry/src/components/colored-badge/index.tsx` | Wraps the workspace `Badge` with `variant="outline"` always, plus the `COLOR_CLASSES` color overlay via `cn`. Exports `ColoredBadge` and `ColoredBadgeDemo`. |
| Consumer | `registry/.../ds-colored-badge/ds-colored-badge.tsx` | **Raw `<span>`.** No Badge primitive, no Base UI. Manual styling: `inline-flex items-center rounded-md border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium` + the same `COLOR_CLASSES` overlay. Exports `DsColoredBadge`. |

**Classification.** Showcase is `showcase-shim`.

**Drift axes present.**

- `showcase-vs-consumer-styling` — **concrete divergence observed** (see below).
- `consumer-vs-workspace-styling` — consumer does not import the workspace `Badge`. Conceptual relation only.

**Current state — concrete divergence.**

The `COLOR_CLASSES` map literal is identical between the showcase tree and the consumer tree — verified by direct read, same 8 keys (`blue`, `green`, `red`, `yellow`, `orange`, `purple`, `pink`, `gray`), same class strings (`bg-{color}-500/10 text-{color}-500 border-{color}-500/20`).

What differs is the **base visual**:

| Aspect | Showcase render | Consumer install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base element | Badge primitive | raw `<span>` |
| Shape | `rounded-4xl` (pill) | `rounded-md` (rounded rectangle) |
| Height | `h-5` (fixed) | `inline-flex` (intrinsic, controlled by padding) |
| Padding | `px-2 py-0.5` | `px-2.5 py-0.5` |
| Focus ring | yes (Badge primitive) | none |
| Slot/aria machinery | yes (Badge primitive) | none |
| Hover/focus state | yes (Badge primitive) | none |

A user who sees `ds-colored-badge` rendered on `ui.deessejs.com/blocks`/detail-page gets a pill-shaped Badge. The same user, after `npx shadcn add deessejs/ui/ds-colored-badge`, gets a flatter span-styled element. **This is silent visual drift already present in v1.**

**Recommended action.** Two viable paths, both valid:

- (a) Make `ds-colored-badge.tsx` match the showcase rendering — author it as `import { Badge } from "@base-ui/react/badge"` (or a near-equivalent) with the pill-shape class string already used by the workspace Badge, then keep `COLOR_CLASSES` on top. Requires `ds-colored-badge` to declare `@base-ui/react@^1.6.0` in `dependencies`.
- (b) Keep `ds-colored-badge.tsx` as a span, but update the showcase tree's `coloured-badge` rendering to use the consumer's `<span>` directly (re-export from the consumer source). This is Phase 5 of the drift plan in practice.

Path (b) is preferred because it collapses a tree without inflating dependencies on `@base-ui/react`. Implementation requires the Phase 5 collapse work to land first.

**Risk going forward: HIGH.** The divergence will grow if either side is edited independently. A drift script will catch this immediately on first run.

---

## Cross-cutting observations

1. **The audit confirms a three-tree problem** for button-shaped items (workspace source + showcase + consumer), not just a two-tree problem. The original `2026-07-29-drift-detection.md` plan framed this as "showcase vs consumer", but the real situation is "workspace vs consumer, with showcase as a passive re-export window for one of them." The drift script in Phase 2 of that plan needs to compare `packages/ui/src/components/<x>.tsx` against `registry/base-nova/<id>/<id>.tsx`, not just the showcase tree.

2. **Current alignment is by-author-construction.** All three consumer files in `registry/base-nova/` were authored by copying the workspace source at v1 creation. There is no enforcement — the next edit to either side breaks the match without warning.

3. **The 8-color `COLOR_CLASSES` duplication is the most visible redundancy** for `ds-colored-badge`. Identical literal in showcase and consumer. A drift script should treat this specific map as a strict equality check.

4. **Export-name divergence is intentional** but creates a discoverability gap. New contributors find `Button` exported in the showcase tree, grep the registry tree, and find nothing named `Button`. The drift script should tolerate the divergence but the audit doc should be linked from `registry/CONTRIBUTING.md` so contributors learn the convention.

5. **The audit found a **concrete, currently-observable** visual divergence** on `ds-colored-badge`. This is not a future risk — it is a present-state bug that ships in v1.

---

## Recommendations for the Phase 2 drift script

Per the tolerance policy in [[2026-07-29-drift-detection]], Phase 2 should implement:

- **Workspace ↔ consumer comparison** for `ds-button` and `ds-icon-button` (workspace source exists, both are independent impls).
  - Strict: `cva()` `variants` keys + class-string values match.
  - Permissive: import paths, export names, function-component wrapping.
- **Showcase ↔ consumer comparison** for all three.
  - Strict: `COLOR_CLASSES` map literal equality (`ds-colored-badge`).
  - Strict: `SIZE_CLASSES` ↔ `iconButtonVariants` mapping equality (`ds-icon-button`).
  - Loose: showcase tree's exports match a known set `{Component, ComponentDemo}`. Consumer's exports match `{DsX, variants}` or close.
- **Workspace-based "showcase-shim" sanity check.** For each item classified `showcase-shim`, the script should verify the showcase tree's `import` resolves to `@workspace/ui/components/<id>`. Today, that holds for `button` and `colored-badge` (`icon-button` doesn't import from workspace because there's no workspace `icon-button`).

Expected output of the script: `scripts/registry-drift.allowlist.json` (per Phase 2 of the plan).

---

## Confidence and uncertainties

- All class-string comparisons above are direct reads — fully verifiable. Open the files, see the strings.
- The "no workspace icon-button file exists" claim was confirmed by `ls packages/ui/src/components/` listing `badge`, `breadcrumb`, `button`, `empty`, `tabs` only.
- The "badge shapes differ" claim was confirmed by reading both files' base class strings. Workspace uses `rounded-4xl`; consumer uses `rounded-md`. No guess.
- The CVA `variant` and `size` keys match across workspace and consumer for `ds-button` was confirmed character-by-character.
- **Not verified:** how `tailwind-merge` (declared in `dependencies` of both workspace `@workspace/ui/lib/utils.ts` and the contract-test consumer shim) resolves any duplicate-class collisions between workspace styling and consumer overrides on `ds-colored-badge`. Out of scope for drift detection, but worth noting — could be a secondary source of visual drift.
